name: Aarya De Chabenet
source:
MAGIC AFFINITY: UNSPECIFIED 

The House of Chabenet is known for their unique and mysterious Deviant powers since ancient times; however, Aarya seem: to be an exception to them, being the sole elemental mage born in generations. 

Despite this, nobody will dare deny their powerful magical abilities. 

With a gentle smile always gracing their lips, Aarya hides an unyielding personality, tenacious vitality, and perhaps a touch of something much, much more....

[From Kickstarter]
